# thinking-orbs

`lib/hm/avatar/thinking_orbs.dart` is a Dart port of the thinking-orbs
geometry engine (MIT, `LICENSE` here), from
Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev@14ae9d2 `packages/thinking-orbs/src/engine`
(npm `thinking-orbs` 0.3.2, https://libraries.dev/orbs).

`test/hm/thinking_orbs_test.dart` holds the port to upstream's golden vectors
(`spec/orbs-golden.json`, copied to `test/hm/fixtures/`).
